E1.evidence: The issue gives full action server and client reproducer scripts plus tracemalloc output; maintainer Barry-Xu-2018 reproduced it: "For client, resident memory is changed from 92M to 194M." and "So there's definitely an issue here with the client." -- https://github.com/ros2/rclpy/issues/1371

E2.evidence: The growth is inside the client process and comes from rclpy's own executor logic, independent of what any correct caller or peer does: "Each time spin_once_until_future_complete() is called, the same callback is added to the future's done callback. ... This way, the future's done callbacks keep accumulating. When a future is completed (calls set_result()), _schedule_or_invoke_done_callbacks() is called. In this function, it creates a Task for each done callback, which leads to many unnecessary Tasks being created and consuming more and more memory." -- https://github.com/ros2/rclpy/pull/1374. Maintainer fujitatomoya states the application code is correct: "i think that the following application code does nothing wrong? after all, my take here is API is not implemented as designed" -- https://github.com/ros2/rclpy/issues/1371. The action server's memory did not grow ("For server, Resident memory hasn't changed much (86M to 87M)."), so no value crossing a boundary between server and client is implicated. This is a leak inside one process (rclpy's executor), ineligible `internal`.

E3.evidence: Not evaluated past E2; the reproduction is a PAIR-style loop (client sends goals to the server), but the defect does not depend on the pairing.

E4.evidence: Observed effect: "Memory consumption from the client  increases overtime" -- https://github.com/ros2/rclpy/issues/1371

ineligible_reason: internal: memory growth caused by rclpy's executor adding a done callback to the same future on every spin_once_until_future_complete call; a leak inside one process that would occur with any correct caller or peer.
notes: Fix: rolling PR 1374 (merge c009b0de286101da1caedef860b88f1520edb97b, merged 2024-10-25) and its jazzy backport PR 1530 (merge 89ff39136d8a308261af40d5ae7a01506898330e, merged 2025-12-26) route spin_until_future_complete through a new private _spin_once_until_future_complete that does not call future.add_done_callback. The reporter used rclpy binaries 7.5.0-1noble.20240919.221552 with Fast-RTPS (tracemalloc paths under /opt/ros/rolling). Barry-Xu-2018 noted after the fix: "In my environment, the client memory still increases a bit, but it's much less than before." An earlier maintainer comment attributed part of the growth to unprocessed tasks accumulating across repeated spin_until_future_complete calls; that too is executor-internal.
